correctness.rationale: Affine arclength fractions remain uniform on each side. Almost surely the three corner triangles and sampled central triangle partition the host. A corner has probability F(x,y)=1-x-y-xy log[(1-x)(1-y)/(xy)]; exact integration from x/(1-y) to 1 and summing three corners gives the stated Σt(1-t)log((1-t)/t). The sign and monotonicity of φ' show strict pairwise equalization (Schur concavity) even across t=1/2; centroid maximum 2log2/3, zero host boundary, fixed-direction vertex expansion εH(q)+O_q(ε²log(1/ε)), and spatial mean 1/4 follow analytically. Independent SymPy integral and three direct simulated inclusion rates with 100,000 trials each corroborate; finite checks are not the proof.
